subject: Streamline.AI — proposal for evidence-led preapproval lane for small-ticket vendors
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_c@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_f@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Streamline.AI small-engagement payment path proposal

Hi Naomi,

Quick one — Streamline.AI (prospect moving to POC) asked if we can avoid full PO for the first 90 days. The engagement is small: expected invoices ~ $1.5–3k/month while they ramp. Sales is worried procurement gating will add 2–3 weeks of delay.

I attached a one-pager SOW and rough scope-of-work for the engagement. Suggested path from my side: a time-limited preapproval lane conditioned on a short evidence checklist (W-9, company registration, invoice sample, monthly cap). If procurement is comfortable, we can put an internal flag so finance knows these are preapproved during the trial period.

Can you advise on what evidence would be sufficient and whether Procurement can sign off for a 90-day window without a PO? If not, what minimal PO/exemption paperwork would you need?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: scope-of-work-streamline.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_f@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_c@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Streamline.AI small-engagement payment path proposal

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the SOW. Quick thoughts: an evidence-led preapproval lane can work for small-ticket, time-bound pilots, but Procurement will need a firm checklist and an owner for monitoring spend against the cap.

Can you confirm the following and forward any vendor documents:
- Legal entity and country of registration
- W-9 or equivalent tax form
- Billing email and invoice format (PDF preferred)
- Proposed monthly cap and invoicing cadence

If the vendor is US-registered and we have W-9 + sample invoice that maps to the SOW items, I can draft a conditional approval proposal to route to Procurement for sign-off. Ideally we also capture the PO-exception duration (e.g., 90 days) and an internal owner to close the loop.

If Ben or I can get Procurement's green light, Finance will accept a labelled "preapproved-invoice" tag for the period and route payments normally.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@streamline.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_f@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_c@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Streamline.AI small-engagement payment path proposal

Hi Naomi + Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply — attaching the items you requested. Short answers below:
- Legal entity: Streamline AI, Inc. (Delaware C-corp)
- W-9: attached (streamline_w9.pdf)
- Billing: billing@streamline.ai — sample invoice attached (streamline_sample-invoice.pdf)
- Cap: we can set a $5,000/month cap during the initial trial (they expect ~ $1.5–3k but want headroom)

We can accept a 90-day preapproval window and will mark invoices "Preapproved Trial — Redwood" if that helps Finance routing. Let me know if you need additional evidence (insurance certificate, corporate registry extract).

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Streamline.AI

Attachments: streamline_w9.pdf (PDF, 42 KB); streamline_sample-invoice.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_f@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_c@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed conditional approval: Streamline.AI (evidence-led, 90-day window)

Team —

I reviewed Streamline.AI's materials. Recommend the following conditional approval for the upcoming POC:

Proposal (summary):
- Duration: 90 days (starting on first vendor invoice)
- Eligibility criteria (all required): W-9 on file, Delaware registration extract, sample invoice matching SOW, internal spend owner assigned (Marissa Cole), monthly cap not to exceed $5,000
- Invoicing instructions: vendor to mark invoices "Preapproved Trial — Redwood" and send to billing@redwood.com; Finance to accept without PO for the 90-day window
- Controls: procurement will audit 2 random invoices during the window; if SOW mismatch or overage occurs, revert to full PO requirements

Rationale: low dollar exposure, vendor responsiveness, and the SOW scope are limited. This will prevent sales delays and allow the POC to proceed. Attachment: summary evidence listed above and SOW (in Drive).

Requesting Procurement sign-off or requested edits. If approved, please return the attached procurement-approval-form completed so Finance can enable the preapproved tag.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman | Procurement Operations Manager
Attachment: (linked) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_procurement_streamline
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_f@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_c@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_c@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@streamline.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed conditional approval: Streamline.AI (evidence-led, 90-day window)

Naomi —

Approved with one minor edit: require vendor to send invoices to billing@redwood.com and cc procurement@redwood.com for the first two invoices so we can validate tagging and SOW line items. Otherwise fine to proceed.

I attached the standard procurement-approval-form. Marissa — please complete the "internal owner" section and return. Finance, please enable the "Preapproved Trial" label for Streamline.AI invoices for 90 days from first invoice date.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement-approval-form.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)
